info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Loan Products Management API
info.description: The Loan Products Management API enables financial institutions to update and manage their loan products efficiently. Through this API, users can modify existing loan product details, ensuring that the offerings remain relevant to market standards and consumer needs. Typical consumers of this API include banking software developers and financial service providers who need to enhance their loan product portfolio dynamically. The API facilitates seamless integration with other financial services, ensuring a comprehensive product management experience.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to update the details of a specific loan product identified by its ID. Ensure that all required fields are provided in the request to successfully update the product's information.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the loan product identified by LOAN-500045. It contains all necessary properties and fields required to modify the existing loan product details.
